claims.text: The dataset was created based on hotel reviews from TripAdvisor.
HotelRec contains approximately 50 million reviews collected from TripAdvisor.
The dataset includes user profiles, hotel URLs, overall ratings, summaries, user-written texts, dates, and sub-ratings.
